eval_metrics.description: Calls get_accounts, then get_equity_positions with account_number and get_crypto_positions with rhs_account_number (never rhc_account_number), following pagination cursors
get_equity_quotes is called with at most 20 symbols and get_equity_historicals with at most 10 symbols per call
Filters for stocks, crypto, or both as requested
Separate tables per account when there are several; a single 'My Holdings' set when there is one
Percentages, dollar changes, position values and sorting come from compute_gainers_losers.py, not mental math
Holdings without prices or references (including crypto week/month) are listed as not included with a reason, never estimated
No orders, cancellations, exercises or alerts are created while running the skill
